title: Sultanate central administration
quote: Balban: Zil-i-Ilahi, the Shadow of God; Alauddin: kingship knows no kinship

boxes.title: Theory of kingship
head: Sultan
Theory / claim
rows: Legitimacy via caliphal investiture (**mansur**, Abbasid Caliph of **Baghdad**, c.**1229**)
State above ulema; "kingship knows no kinship"; **Sikandar-i-Sani**
Rationalist absolutism; investiture from Caliph in **Egypt**; "Al Sultan Zilli Allah"

boxes.title: The Sultan & the state
items: Sultan = Caliph's representative; supreme commander + ==highest court of appeal==
**No fixed succession**: nobles, ulema, army decided
**Sharia** for Muslims' civil matters; Hindus kept own law; **zawabit** = royal decrees

items.what: Iltutmish's ==**Chalisa**== (The Forty); Balban, one of them, **destroyed** it
**Khalji revolution**: non-Turks, Indian Muslims in office
Afghan nobles: Sultan = first among equals

boxes.title: Exam corner
items: "Alauddin first set up separate Ariz department" = ==false== (Balban)
**Mir Bakshi** did not exist under Sultans: Mughal (UPSC 2019)
Coins: **Ghori** = Lakshmi + Kalma; **Mahmud Ghazni** = Arabic + Sanskrit
AP: Qutb Shahi **Peshwa** = PM (last: **Madanna**); Bahmani PM = **Wakil-us-Saltanat**
